<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

type Menu = { id: number }

const menus = ref<Menu[][]>([[{ id: 1 }]])
const menuList = ref<unknown[]>([])
</script>

<template>
  <Child
    v-for="(menu, index) in menus"
    :key="index"
    :ref="(item) => (menuList[index] = item as unknown)"
    :nodes="[...menu]"
  />
</template>
